summary: Global Interactive Technologies, Inc. filed a Form 8-K under Items 1.01, 3.02, and 9.01 to disclose a Securities Purchase Agreement entered into on June 25, 2026, for a PIPE investment raising approximately $2 million in gross proceeds. The Company issued pre-funded warrants (exercise price $0.001) and common stock warrants (exercise price $1.83, 5.5-year term) to purchase up to 1,092,896 shares each, at a purchase price of $1.829 per unit. The private placement closed on June 29, 2026. Net proceeds will be used to repay an undisclosed obligation and for general corporate purposes. This is a routine capital raise, not a transformative special situation.
